description: This file defines the LoanProductPaymentAllocationRuleMerger class which provides functionality to merge and update payment allocation rules within a loan product, including addition, removal, and modification of rules based on transaction types.

classes.name: LoanProductPaymentAllocationRuleMerger
classes.description: A utility class to manage the merging and updating of payment allocation rules for loan products in the system.

methods.name: updateProductPaymentAllocationRules
methods.description: Updates the payment allocation rules of a given LoanProduct with a new set of rules, handling additions, deletions, and modifications. Returns true if any changes were made.

methods.name: mergeLoanProductPaymentAllocationRule
methods.description: Merges two LoanProductPaymentAllocationRule instances, updating fields if they differ, and returns true if any field was changed.
